headwords: thả cá nhỏ, bắt cá lớn
thất bại là mẹ thành công

flags.why: This is a formal term for elimination, especially in medical contexts, rather than an ordinary conversational verb.
The physical action is the literal meaning of the Chinese source expression, whereas Vietnamese thảng bình names the social trend ([reference](https://vi.wikipedia.org/wiki/Th%E1%BA%A3ng_b%C3%ACnh)).
Thấm thoát expresses how quickly time has passed; the example's gần supplies the meaning 'nearly'.
flags.fix: Merge this example into sense 1 and remove the gloss 'already nearly'.

flags.why: Thất chí belongs mainly to literary or formal usage and is misleading without a register warning ([reference](https://vdict.com/th%E1%BA%A5t%20ch%C3%AD%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
The example defines a heptagon instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Em vẽ một hình thất giác vào vở. = I drew a heptagon in my notebook.

flags.why: The expression describes people being thrown into turmoil or distress, making its use for an untidy room misleading ([reference](https://huyenbi.net/Tu-dien-Thanh-ngu-Tuc-ngu-Viet-Nam/Giai-nghia-tu-That-dien-bat-dao-3568.html)).
flags.fix: Mất việc rồi lại mắc nợ, anh ấy thất điên bát đảo. = Losing his job and then falling into debt left him in turmoil.
